Senses.Explanation: Something described as ready-made stands complete and available without further fabrication. Chan records repeatedly apply the word to what is immediately usable and especially to a public case already at hand. Yuanwu Keqin says the whole operation is ready-made wherever one touches. Deshan Mi calls one who comes in this way a ready-made public case. Tianru Weize says each one is already there; Wanru Tongwei says this matter is originally ready-made and does not depend on fabrication; Binya Jian describes using what is ready-made rather than seeking a guide elsewhere. Xu Fang's preface says everything is ready-made where no further construction is needed. The common compound “ready-made public case” also receives active hall use: Jingyin Weiyue places it before further instruction, while Miyun Yuanwu says everyone has one and immediately stages an objection and a staff blow. Yuanwu uses the older graph form when raising Wuzu Fayan's ready-made public case. Zen bends an ordinary adjective of availability into recurrent public-case and teaching-seat language, but the adjective, its older spelling, and its compounds continue to name one state rather than different things.
Senses.Note: Allowlist count: 1,749 hits in 292 texts. The dominant compound, ready-made public case, occurs 382 times in 154 texts; the older graphic form occurs in the same deployment. Item 8 re-adjudication finds no hidden semicolon split: adjectival uses, public-case compounds, and ready-for-use constructions all point to something already formed and available. The older graph is a spelling, not another sense.

Occurrences.Kwic: 全機大用，觸處現成，溢目清光
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of Guiding Principles from the Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄), in Yuanwu Keqin's imperially commanded opening-hall address: the whole operation is ready-made wherever one touches.

Occurrences.Kwic: 與麼來者，現成公案。不與麼來者，垛生招箭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of Guiding Principles from the Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄), in a hall address attributed by the section heading to Deshan Mi: one who comes in this way is a ready-made public case. Deshan Mi is source-attested and not yet represented in the local roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 正緣五祖老師有箇見成公案。對眾舉揚。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu (圓悟佛果禪師語錄), spoken by Yuanwu Keqin in a hall address: using the older graph, he raises Wuzu Fayan's ready-made public case before the assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當下七通八達，一一現成、一一圓妙
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianru Weize (天如惟則禪師語錄), spoken by Tianru Weize in an instruction to the assembly: each one is already there and fully effective.

Occurrences.Kwic: 更有不煩掃建處，一切現成
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Record of Chan Master Juelang Daosheng of Tianjie (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄), in a preface written by the layman Xu Fang: everything is ready-made where no further sweeping or construction is required. Xu Fang is source-attested and not represented in the master roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若論此事，本自現成，不假造作，只貴當人回光返照
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wanru (萬如禪師語錄), spoken by Wanru Tongwei in a hall address: this matter is originally ready-made and does not depend on fabrication.

Occurrences.Kwic: 自然穩坐家堂，現成受用，何須航海梯山，別求良導？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Binya (斌雅禪師語錄), spoken by Binya Jian: one sits securely at home and uses what is ready-made rather than crossing seas and mountains to seek another guide. Binya Jian is source-attested and not yet represented in the local roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 未挂古帆，現成公案。由是悟取無悟底面目，迷是不迷底鄉關。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps, Volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), under Jingyin Weiyue: his opening-hall address places the ready-made public case before its further public exposition.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云：「山僧本志亦只如然，秪緣人人有個現成公案，出來相為了卻。忽有個衲僧出來道：『既是現成公案，因甚卻要了？』」驀拈拄杖打云：「橫按莫邪全正令，太平寰宇斬癡頑。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Miyun (密雲禪師語錄), spoken by Miyun Yuanwu: he says everyone has a ready-made public case, stages an objection before the assembly, and answers it with a staff blow and verse.
